correctness.rationale: The rank-one row sum has finite trace norm because sum |a_n|sqrt(n+1) converges. Row phases vanish under a diagonal output unitary. Every m-row lower triangular block L_m has exact singular numbers [2sin((2j-1)pi/(4m+2))]^{-1}, reconstructed from its inverse difference tridiagonal. Grouping indices at n~R and comparing row moduli to c/(xR)^2 yields bulk counting integral int F(x)dx; interblock interactions have rank at most the number of output blocks, small initial rows rank O(epsilon R), high dyadic blocks count O(R/L), and rows n>MR² have norm <=C c/(M R²) for threshold t=c/R². Thus full infinite counting N(t)/sqrt(c/t) tends to Beta(1/4,1/2)/(pi sqrt2), and monotone inversion gives j^-2 asymptotics and S_p boundary. Cesaro row difference telescopes to k/((n+1)(n+k+1)) and trace H_k. Independent 7 finite-block spectra, 3 exact Cesaro coefficient families, and beta integral evaluation agree. The bounded finite checks are not an infinite-dimensional certificate.
residual_risks: The tests are finite and do not replace the all-parameter proof.
